semiconductor_relevance: High — Leadtech provides specialized equipment for semiconductor fabrication and testing, particularly for high-voltage GaN devices and panel-level packaging.
summary: Leadtech designs and manufactures automated machinery for the semiconductor industry, focusing on equipment for high-voltage GaN-compatible devices. Their offerings include switching characteristic testers, slit coaters for panel-level packaging and solar cell applications, as well as vacuum dryers, hot plates, cold plates, and robotic handling systems.
capabilities: Switching characteristic testers for high-voltage GaN devices
Slit coaters for panel-level packaging and solar cells
Vacuum dryers, hot plates, and cold plates
